rv.q: He is “hilarious” as he “fires off the double-entendres at a rate of knots”
I wholeheartedly confess that Robin Hood has made a merry man out of me.
This Robin Hood would be better titled The Julian Clary Show.

cn.t: Julian Clary leads another crowd-pleasing Palladium panto with his signature smutty humor, backed by extravagant costumes and OTT production values. Critics find it a festive bullseye that prioritizes laughs over plot.
